landing.hero.title: A calm, simple way to run your subscription store
landing.hero.description: Sell access, accept payments, and give customers a clear subscription experience through Telegram and the web.

landing.login.title: Sign in to your account
landing.login.description: Press the button and confirm in the Telegram window. You can also open your account from the bot with «Open account».

landing.features.title: Telegram-first
landing.features.text: Buy, renew and get help without leaving the chat.

landing.features.title: Payments that fit
landing.features.text: Cards, crypto, Telegram Stars and an account balance.

landing.features.title: One clear link
landing.features.text: A single subscription link with QR and client shortcuts.

landing.steps: Open the Telegram bot or sign in on the site.
Choose a plan and pay with a convenient method.
Add the subscription link to your client and connect.

landing.faq.question: Do I need a card for the trial?
landing.faq.answer: No. When the store owner enables the trial, it starts straight from the bot.

landing.faq.question: Can I change my plan later?
landing.faq.answer: Yes. The remaining days of the current plan are credited towards the new one.

landing.faq.question: What happens when a subscription expires?
landing.faq.answer: Access pauses after the grace period. Renewing restores the same subscription link.

landing.faq.question: Where do I get support?
landing.faq.answer: Use the support contact in the footer or write to the Telegram bot.

landing.ctaText: Start in the Telegram bot, or sign in to open your account on the web.
